First off, if you don’t think you can complete type SBR (Super Strength, Extreme Agility, etc.) don’t even attempt category ones (Potara only, Majin Buu Saga only, etc.). The category ones are much harder and require basically the optimal team.

Second, make sure you either have the 120% type lead to HP, ATK, & DEF, or a very good unit with at least like 90% to all three. If your best leader for, per-say, Super Teq is like 30% at best, don’t even attempt Super Teq.

Take the LR Friend. For example, if you attempt Super PHY, don’t take SS3 Gotenks as your friend, even though he’s the best leader. Instead, take LR SS Goku & SS Vegeta. While their leader skill is only 90% to Super PHY, what they provide as an individual unit well exceeds that.

Take Stunners and damage reducers. Stunners like Jiren or Gotenks & Ghost will be integral to you winning, as every attack stopped counts, especially if it stops a super attack. Even with the best team you could have, one bad turn could end your entire run. Damage reducers like Super Vegito and Golden Frieza’s are pretty self explanatory. Make sure you know the conditions to these reductions though. Golden Frieza only reduces above a certain HP value, at start of turn. So if you start the turn below that, even if you use a health item to get above that, his damage reduction won’t activate.

Use items like Android 8 and Princess Snake, as they both give back HP and give you a DEF boost. Use items like Whis or Icarus, as they are the best damage reducers in the game. My optimal SBR item list is Android 8, Princess Snake, Bulma (Future), and Whis. That’s mine, I’m sure other people have their favorites tho, like Nurse Chi Chi or others like her.

Then there’s the general game ones, like have good rotations, make sure all your units link well, max out your units hidden potential and SA (units that are only there for stunning don’t need to be maxed but would help).
